This workflow covers two examples: 1. Visual counting with RL: Create a visual star-count environment for Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct, scale training, and improve reported accuracy from 25.0% to 96.875%. 2. summary: 브릴스가 코스닥 상장을 위한 증권신고서를 제출하고 IPO 절차에 들어갔으며, 신주 120만 주를 공모해 약 200억 원을 조달할 계획이다. 로봇 모듈화 플랫폼 솔루션을 앞세운 기업으로, 이번 상장은 국내 로봇 기업의 기술 경쟁력을 자본시장과 연결해 글로벌 확장을 추진하는 사례로 볼 수 있다.

title: 499억 투입 ‘AI 국방로봇 충남·논산 방산혁신클러스터’ 조성 시동
summary: Chungnam Province has begun setting up an AI defense-robotics innovation cluster in Nonsan, formalized through an agreement with the Defense Acquisition Program Administration and Nonsan City after winning the 2026 defense innovation cluster competition. The project commits 49.9 billion won to build a regional defense-industry hub around AI-enabled military robots, linking local government, defense agencies, and research institutions to accelerate industrial development in a strategically important robotics area.

title: 삼성전자 키즈 로봇, ‘레드닷 어워드 2026’ 디자인 콘셉트 부문 최고상
summary: Samsung’s children’s robots Dremo & Minimo won Best of the Best in the Design Concept category at the Red Dot Design Award 2026. The recognition signals Samsung’s continued push into child-oriented companion robotics, with the robots positioned less as general home assistants than as designed interactive products for kids.

title: SK인텔릭스, 웰니스 로봇 ‘나무엑스’ 지자체 공공실증사업 연속 선정
summary: SK Intellix’s wellness robotics brand NAMUHX has been selected for two consecutive municipal public-demonstration projects, signaling a more serious push into public-sector robot deployments. In Gangnam-gu’s 3rd Robot(AI) Testbed program, the robot will be tested for visitor health and emotional-care services alongside AI-based, space-specific air-quality management, with deployments spanning urban public facilities and natural recreation settings.
